title: Thanks, friends in Scotland and England!
excerpt: I’m just catching up – on sleep and email – after a tremendous trip to Scotland and England. What wonderful people I had the chance to meet and converse with. And what a great job the hosts and organizers did in putting the events together. I’m deeply grateful.
